articles.title: Apple beats US appeal claiming it shortchanged customers on iCloud storage
articles.content: (Reuters) -A U.S. federal appeals court on Wednesday rejected claims by Apple customers that the iPhone maker gave them less iCloud data storage than they paid for when upgrading.
